guidelines.detail: same as LRN-013 (The description explicitly lists alternative methods, and the missing activity and flows show that one method and its branch were not modeled. This is already covered by learned guideline LRN-013.)

same as LRN-006 (The description explicitly lists alternative identification methods. The missing method and the matched method tasks support preserving the alternatives as separate tasks; LRN-006 already expresses this guideline.)

refines FID-01 (The description explicitly lists three alternative identification methods, while the reference includes a task and flow for one method that the generated model lacks. This guideline refines FID-01 by specifying how to preserve stated alternatives in the model.)

same as LRN-094 (The description explicitly states three alternative methods, while the generated model has no counterpart for one of them. The learned guideline LRN-094 already addresses this situation.)

same as LRN-094 (The description explicitly lists compression identification as one of three alternative methods, but the reference task has no counterpart in the generated model. LRN-094 already gives the same modeling guidance.)

documentation rule FID-01 not applied (The description states three alternative identification methods, and the evidence shows that two were modeled while the compression alternative had no counterpart. FID-01 already requires modeling every distinct activity and branch stated in the description, so this guideline is already covered.)

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description presents multiple distinct activities as optional alternatives: Model each activity separately on an appropriate branch, rather than combining the alternatives into one activity, and preserve their connection to the subsequent flow.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description gives multiple alternative methods for completing the same step

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description states that an action has mutually exclusive alternatives for how or where it is carried out: Model the choice with an exclusive gateway and a separate task for each alternative.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description states that an activity can be performed using one of several alternative methods

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description lists multiple alternative methods for performing one activity: Model each stated method on a separate branch of an exclusive split, then merge the alternatives before the shared continuation; do not omit any stated method.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description lists multiple alternative methods for performing one activity

rules_sent_back.instruction: Model every distinct activity, event, participant, decision, branch, loop, message and outcome stated in the description. Do not invent process facts.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description explicitly lists multiple distinct alternatives for carrying out one step
